name: translytical
title: Translytical (Operational Writeback from Power BI)
description: Architecture blueprint for Translytical task flows: a transactional SQL Database holds operational data, User Data Functions expose write logic, and a Power BI report triggers those functions to write back (update records, send notifications, trigger workflows) directly from the report. Best for decision-and-action apps where analytics and operational writeback live together.
best_for: Operational decision-making with writeback INSIDE a Power BI report — approve/adjust/annotate records, trigger notifications or workflows, without leaving the report.
key_ingestion: Application/report writeback via User Data Functions (not batch ingestion)

item_set.purpose: Transactional store for the operational records being written back (F4+ capacity)
Write logic invoked from the report (update/insert, notify, trigger)
Per-stage config (connection targets, thresholds) for promotion
Model over the operational + analytical data
Power BI report with translytical buttons that call the UDFs
Optional Activator to trigger downstream actions on writeback events

decisions.guidance: User Data Functions encapsulate validated write logic callable from the report (the translytical pattern); direct SQL only for trusted server-side callers.
Translytical requires an OLTP store with read/write transactions — SQL Database (needs F4+ capacity). Lakehouse/Warehouse are read-mostly and NOT suitable for record-level writeback.
Send notifications inside the UDF for synchronous feedback; use an Activator for async downstream workflows.

build_with.deploy_ordering: VariableLibrary + SQLDatabase (Environment/Foundation) before UserDataFunction, then SemanticModel -> Report; fabio deploy handles ordering.
outline: Create the SQL Database (requires F4+ capacity).
Author User Data Functions for the write operations (update/insert, notify, trigger).
Build a semantic model + Power BI report; wire report buttons to invoke the UDFs (translytical).
Add a Variable Library for per-environment config; promote via fabio deploy (see workflow cicd-deploy).
Optionally add an Activator for downstream workflows on writeback events.
